about_p1: Welcome to dsoimage.com. I'm Shimon Avitan, and this site is a curated gallery of my deep-sky astrophotography: galaxies, nebulae, and star clusters captured from Israel under dark skies whenever conditions allow.
about_p2: My goal is to present each target clearly and honestly—showing structure, color, and fine detail—while keeping the viewing experience fast and clean (preview images open into full-resolution frames with notes and links).
about_p3: If you'd like to follow new work, you can find links in the sidebar. If you're interested in the hardware and workflow behind the images, visit the Equipment page.
contact_intro: Have a question about my imaging process, equipment, or potential prints? Feel free to reach out using the form below.
